pull.title: test: cover SelectionResult::Merge, GetTotalBumpFees and EligibleForSpending
pull.body:
Adds tests that kill two surviving mutants in `src/wallet/coinselection.cpp`.

**`SelectionResult::Merge()`** (https://bitcoincore.space/src/wallet/coinselection.cpp#3707)

```diff
-    if (m_algo == SelectionAlgorithm::MANUAL) {
+    if (m_algo != SelectionAlgorithm::MANUAL) {
```

With this mutant, merged results report the wrong algorithm. The test fails with `manual != bnb`.

**`SelectionResult::GetTotalBumpFees()`** (https://bitcoincore.space/src/wallet/coinselection.cpp#3700)

```diff
-    return std::accumulate(...) - bump_fee_group_discount;
+    return std::accumulate(...) + bump_fee_group_discount;
```

With this mutant, the wallet overpays fees. The test fails with `90 != 30`.
OutputGroup::EligibleForSpending() (https://bitcoincore.space/src/wallet/coinselection.cpp#3683)
```diff
- return m_depth >= (m_from_me ? eligibility_filter.conf_mine : eligibility_filter.conf_theirs)
+ return m_depth > (m_from_me ? eligibility_filter.conf_mine : eligibility_filter.conf_theirs)
```
With this mutant, a coin with exactly the required number of confirmations is incorrectly rejected. The test checks that a coin with exactly the required confirmations is eligible, while one with fewer confirmations is not. The test passes on the branch and fails with the mutant applied.

tACK 8d074ed174

Tested on macOS 27.0.1 arm64. 
The `coinselector_tests` suite passes on the PR.
I reproduced both mutations from the description. For each mutation, the PR's suite fails while the suite from master `fb19fed3df` passes:

```text
Merge: == changed to !=
  merge_algo_test: [manual != bnb] in both merge directions

GetTotalBumpFees: group discount added instead of subtracted
  bump_fee_test: selection.GetTotalBumpFees() == 30 has failed [90 != 30]
```

For the second mutation, the initial check against 60 still passes because the discount is zero. The check after applying the 30-sat discount catches the incorrect sign.

events.message:
test: check algorithm after SelectionResult::Merge

No test checks which algorithm a SelectionResult reports after
Merge(). Check that preset (MANUAL) inputs merged into an automatic
result keep the automatic algorithm, and that a MANUAL result takes
the algorithm of the result merged into it.

Kills mutant https://bitcoincore.space/src/wallet/coinselection.cpp#3707

test: check GetTotalBumpFees with a group discount

GetTotalBumpFees() is used to compute the fee a transaction needs,
but no test checks its value. Check it in bump_fee_test before and
after a discount is applied.

Kills mutant https://bitcoincore.space/src/wallet/coinselection.cpp#3700
